description: This file defines the RecurringTimer class used for scheduling repeated callback executions at specified intervals within the Spark Streaming module. It includes methods for starting, stopping, and calculating trigger times, and contains a main method demonstrating its usage.

classes.name: RecurringTimer
classes.description: A utility class for scheduling recurring callbacks at fixed intervals, with start and stop controls.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Calculates the next start time based on the current clock and period.

methods.name: getRestartTime
methods.description: Calculates the restart time based on an original start time and current clock.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the timer at a specified start time.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the timer at the earliest possible start time based on the period.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the timer and returns the last callback time, with optional interruption.

methods.name: triggerActionForNextInterval
methods.description: Executes the callback for the next scheduled interval.

methods.name: loop
methods.description: Main loop that repeatedly triggers callbacks until stopped.
